compute.cost_note: stdlib regex and lexicons; uses spaCy NER for named entities when installed, else a regex fallback

do_not_use_when: you want a quality judgment; the check reports preservation, not whether the revision is better

examples.description: Check a restoration pass for meaning drift

inputs.target: the original text (--before) and the revised text (--after)

purpose: Semantic guardrails over a before/after revision pair. Compares claim inventory, named entities, citations and authorities, stance markers, modal verbs, causal claims and hedges between the two texts and reports per category what was dropped, added and shared, with a verdict (preserved, shifted_dropped, shifted_added, shifted_changed). shifted_added flags restoration edits that make the prose more forceful than the writer was.
use_when: after a voice-restoration or AI-assisted revision, to check the meaning did not shift (added causal claims, removed hedges)
auditing each added stance or causal item before accepting a revision
